research.name: Pixel2Motion
research.note: Agent skill that refits a raster logo into minimal smooth SVG and choreographs a logo reveal as standalone HTML with replay and speed controls.

effects: raster logo refit into minimal smooth SVG with teal overlay strips comparing the vector against the source
logo reveal choreographed part by part (mark draws on, dot pops in, wordmark types out) landing on the verified static vector
showcase HTML with atomic motion studies (hover, pulse, arc, press), animation-principle chips, and replay, slow motion and speed controls
side-by-side Claude and GPT motion studies of the same source logo
